pairs.rationale: Containment repair is useful history for acceptance tests, but explicit distinct task IDs rule out continuation. Writing regression coverage is narrower than implementing the repair; comparative difficulty is unknown.
The common archive context does not make preview reordering relevant to path containment assertions.

Both specified regression objectives cover parent-directory and absolute member paths with no outside writes. Apparent constraints are the same, while authoritative distinct task IDs preserve independence.
